item.title: Siklu EtherHaul rfpiped Unauthenticated Command Execution (CVE-2025-57174)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2025-57174. Status: Weaponized (the upstream README documents a successful command execution against an EH-8010FX-L running firmware 10.7.x; not re-run while preparing this entry). Affects: Ceragon/Siklu EtherHaul series microwave backhaul radios; the rfpiped service on the radio. Tags: RCE, unauthenticated, hardcoded key, AES-CBC, static IV, rfpiped, Siklu, Ceragon, EtherHaul, microwave backhaul, CWE-321.
